Photo notes

The names and occasions that came with the pictures.

## Ellis Vale.jpg

Ellis Vale. The print carries his name and no date.

People named in the caption: Ellis Vale.
Left to right: Ellis Vale.

## Marta Vale.jpg

Marta Vale. An old portrait labelled with her name.

People named in the caption: Marta Vale.
Left to right: Marta Vale.

## Ellis and Marta.jpg

Ellis Vale and Marta Vale. The names came with the photograph; their order was not written down.

People named in the caption: Ellis Vale; Marta Vale.

## The move to Harbourfield.jpg

The family who left Alder Vale for Harbourfield: Ellis, Marta and Jonah. The old caption names Jonah on the left and gives no full order.

People named in the caption: Ellis Vale; Marta Vale; Jonah Vale.

## Jonah Vale.jpg

Jonah Vale on his own. The name came with the photograph.

People named in the caption: Jonah Vale.
Left to right: Jonah Vale.

## Martin Vale.jpg

Martin Vale on his own.

People named in the caption: Martin Vale.
Left to right: Martin Vale.

## Clara Vale.jpg

Clara Vale on her own.

People named in the caption: Clara Vale.
Left to right: Clara Vale.

## Rowan and Martin.jpg

Rowan and Martin Vale at the harbour. No date or left-to-right order was supplied.

People named in the caption: Rowan Vale; Martin Vale.
